questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(8, 12, 24)
questions.solution:
Pattern followed is:

1st term is divisible by 2 i.e. 8 is divisible by 2.

2ⁿd term is divisible by 3 i.e. 12 is divisible by 3.

3rd term is divisible by 6 i.e. 24 is divisible by 6.

Similarly

6 is divisible by 2

9 is divisible by 3

18 is divisible by 6

Hence (6, 9, 18) is answer.

questions.question:
Which number will replace the question mark (?) in the following series?

98, 95, 86, 82, 66, ?, 36
questions.solution:
Pattern followed is:

98 – 3 = 95

95 - 3² = 86

86 – 4 = 82

82 - 4² = 66

**66 – 5 = 61 **

61 - 5² = 36

Hence 61 is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(5, 13, 12)
questions.solution:
Pattern is as follows:

5² + 12² = 13²

Adding square of 1st and 3rd term gives square of 2ⁿd term.

15² + 13² ≠ 19²

**6² + 8² = 10² **

11² + 9² ≠ 15²

13² + 11² ≠ 17²

Hence (6, 10, 8) is the answer.

questions.question:
Select the word-pair in which the two words are related in the same way as are the two words in the following word-pair.

Apathy: Enthusiasm
questions.solution:
Apathy and Enthusiasm are Antonyms.

Condemnation means “very strong disapproval”

Reverence means “a feeling of great respect”

Treaty and Friendship are synonyms

Enrolment and Employment are synonyms

War and Attack are also synonyms.

Hence, "Condemnation: Reverence" is the answer.

questions.question:
Select the number-pair in which the two numbers are related in the same way as are the two numbers of the following number-pair.

7 : 32
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

Number × [ (Number + 1) ÷ 2 ] + { (Number + 1) ÷ 2 } = RHS

7 times [ {( {7 + 1} ) div 2} ] + [ {( {7 + 1} ) div 2} ] = 7 times 4 + 4 = 32

Option 1 :

12 times [ {( {12 + 1} ) div 2} ] + [ {( {12 + 1} ) div 2} ] = 12 times 7.5 + 7.5 ne 85

Option 2 :

16 times [ {( {16 + 1} ) div 2} ] + [ {( {16 + 1} ) div 2} ] = 16 times 8.5 + 8.5 ne 145

Option 3 :

3 times [ {( {3 + 1} ) div 2} ] + [ {( {3 + 1} ) div 2} ] = 3 times 2 + 2 ne 11

Option 4 :

13 times [ {( {13 + 1} ) div 2} ] + [ {( {13 + 1} ) div 2} ] = 13 times 7 + 7 = 98

Hence, **13 : 98** is answer.

questions.question: Two mixtures contain milk and juice in the ratio of 2 : 1 and 4 : 5. If equal volumes of the two mixtures are mixed together, what would be ratio of milk to juice in the resulting mixture?
questions.solution:
Ratio of milk and juice in Mixture 1 = 2 : 1

Ratio of milk and juice in Mixture 2 = 4 : 5

Given, equal volumes of the two mixtures are mixed together

According to the question,

Ratio of milk to juice in resulting mixture = (m1 + m2) / (j1 + j2)

⇒ (2/3 + 4/9) / (1/3 + 5/9)

⇒ (10/9) / (8/9)

⇒ 5 : 4

questions.question:
Two statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement.

**Statements:**

No crows is a bird.

All birds are animals.

**Conclusion:**

I. Some animals are crows.

II. Some animals are birds.

III. No animal is a crow.

options.text: Conclusion II and either conclusion I or III follows
Only conclusions I and III follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1efbeec44b3f940a39e1237986a71c3239e801775d446f345dc8c40942c78264.png] 

**Conclusion:**

Some animals are crows → False (Possibility but not definitely true).

Some animals are birds → True.

No animal is a crow → False (Possibility but not definitely true).

Thus, I and III forms a complimentary pair.

Hence, Conclusion II and either conclusion I or III follows.

questions.question: ‘Cinema’ is related to ‘Audience’ in the same way as ‘Church’ is related to ‘_____’.
